name: Chin Tuck

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: APTA Neck Pain Clinical Practice Guidelines

steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and gaze pointed straight ahead at eye level.
Place two fingers lightly on your chin as a tactile guide.
Without tilting your head up or down, glide your chin straight backward as if making a subtle double chin.
Feel a gentle lengthening sensation along the back of your neck and upper spine.
Hold the retracted position for 3 to 5 seconds, then relax your head back to its neutral starting position.
coaching_cues: Move your head straight back horizontally, like closing a desk drawer.
Do not nod your head down or look at your chest.
Perform multiple sets throughout the workday to counteract desk posture.

sources.attribution: APTA Cervical Motor Control Clinical Practice Guidelines
